purpose: Prevent character production from stalling on pre-runtime visual micro-gates. Build the contiguous asset batch first, then validate contact/naturalness in the actual runtime screenshots.

nonBlockingSignals: screen-side ambiguity that is not obviously wrong
PRE_RUNTIME_LIGHTWEIGHT.decision: If blocking checks pass, formal-save/register the candidate and continue building the current contiguous block. Record non-blocking signals for post-runtime review; do not loop on them before implementation.

POST_RUNTIME_VISUAL.when: After all required assets for the contiguous block are formal and mapped into a provisional/runtime-scope candidate build.
requiredChecks: actual app screenshot at target measure/time
no regression in previously completed measures
POST_RUNTIME_VISUAL.repairPolicy: Only assets that are visibly wrong in runtime screenshots return to edit. All other formal assets remain fixed.

antiLoopRules: Do not reject a pre-runtime candidate for contact-point precision alone.
Do not repeat a generation/edit solely because of diff/centroid/edit metadata warnings.
Do not require fixed-drum composite perfection before formal registration when the lightweight hard gate passes.
Batch-complete the current contiguous measure block before detailed visual micro-adjustment.
Runtime screenshot evidence outranks synthetic contact overlays for naturalness/contact decisions.
currentStrategy: Complete the final BD+LT:RF/R pair with lightweight QA, then map M17 1-17 provisionally and perform consolidated PC/Xperia screenshot QA.
